description: One post's numbers over time against the account's usual at the same age, a plain verdict, what it did differently (length, saves, shares, watch time), where viewers stopped watching (a YouTube video's audience curve; Instagram and Facebook give average watch time only) with fix-it notes tied to moments in the video, and what to do next: networks it isn't on yet (post_duplicate with those account_ids), evergreen (evergreen_set), and a brief for making another like it. Use an id from insights_get posts, or an app post_id. next_steps lists those as calls, best first: each apply is the exact call to make (tool and input), and needs names anything the person still gives.

id.description: ID of the post (a UUID): from post_list

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

title: How a post did
